### 2026-10-14 – Oct 14 -2nd work session

**1.4h**

Oct 14 -2nd work session

A few updates from this morning: while at school today, I had some realizations. First, the guide was not going to be helpful for much more than the sketch of the track. Everything else was pretty useless. So I deleted what I had and got started using what I knew, and so far it has gone well.
This is a photo of my NEW sketch, independent of the guide and using my own knowledge. Maybe it's wrong. maybe its perfect.
![Screenshot 2026-10-14 185058](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/5d9953dbc9f9f2970b14b8df68731a62be87c77a1e62bd9f82ef9b737ed06dfb.png)
What I have so far, with it extruded and swept and all that. VAMOS. once you get into a flow, its pretty easy, lol.

Next: print a sample track to see if it will really work, since I'm using custom diameters, designs, and stuff.

### 2026-10-15 – oct 15

**2h**

oct 15
Locking in.
It's already Thursday, and I am behind. So today I locked in and began doing CAD like mad. I extended the track under the first part and added a turn for the ramp. One issue I ran into was that the track was getting twisted when sweeping, so it was upside down. After a Google search, I found the twist tool in Sweep.

My track right before twisting and all my planes.
![Screenshot 2026-10-15 184744](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/f39f5c3671ce1b3815b47879fca2da0c75b839ad9cb52c1a4a0d1c81c07e28ae.png)

Post-twist with extended track and a curve (its hidden)- where i am rn.
![Screenshot 2026-10-15 202233](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/4cdb995667574b94621b364351b977314fa594917d7c14ac7ef6cae2e7090c47.png)

next: keep grinding track

TL;DR: locked in, twisted track, extended.

### 2026-10-17 – Oct 17 — coming closer to the finish.

**5h**

Oct 17 — coming closer to the finish.
Today was focused on extending the track, adding the base and supports (not the ones from a slicer).
First,Ii picked up where I left off, building a ramp jump. Shortly after finishing the ramp, I promptly realized that it was never fitting on the base and deleted it.

Me designing the ramp. You can see the curve of the jump coming up.
![Screenshot 2026-10-16 210104](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/737badfec655bdc83948000b52fc14da9eafbdce292b5a75f5572ac427bd4a13.png)

Then I sadly realized, after considering physics and the overall size of the ramp, that it wasn't going to work and deleted it. Oh well.

I then decided to switch gears into the base. Using a base design I had made and just hidden at the start, I reapplied it and moved and adjusted it with the transform tool. this much harder than it sounds, because getting the angle AND the location just right was difficult.
![Screenshot 2026-10-17 152223](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/0283be0d822413ca4906a5062dd237d0341c0ac94332166853d2a241e49be5c3.png)
I also made a sketch on the face of the base and extruded a cylinder out of it for the main support column.

I also added some other track supports after getting the base aligned.
![Screenshot 2026-10-17 162540](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/c92deef6de5252816b76dc2df452d8c37e661c06340aa59667a76bf03601a071.png)

When I was adding the base, I reworked the start to something more space-efficient. From this, a long start piece
![Screenshot 2026-10-17 144222](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/b07d07d6271f7b7d04e03b6449d875d5ec5a0964e24972e4ec72e7ba463cc971.png)
To this, a much more space-efficient piece.
![Screenshot 2026-10-17 215150](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/9adb8e4339dfbe882512e56c5dbdffc072020543b2c73d9abcac5fc15834d779.png)

After getting the base properly aligned, the start fixed, and supports added I continued making the track. There was only one issue: when I was moving the track to fit the base, I made the critical oversight that the sketches wouldn't move with it. (Transform only moves a part) So I lost all the sketches, which made it a lot harder to continue the track. Luckily, I found a way by making a sketch using points from the sweep's natural points and faces, and made a (bad) turn with a normal sketch to build off of. That wasn't fun.

Building my turn. This isn't the bad one, but one that came later.
![Screenshot 2026-10-17 170039](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/3ac53b51022f5d89bc198bfc29e2ed1f4ce485bf3801dd8e684c44c79c519d39.png)

Next, fix issues with bad turns, finish the track, and do BOM. Ship!!!!

TL;DR: added base, support structures, shortened start, extended track.

### 2026-10-18 – Oct 18 - finished!!

**5.2h**

Oct 18 - finished!!
Today I did a few things. I finished the CAD, the BOM, and the repo.
First, I began finishing the CAD. This took a while because I was having an issue where this one piece wouldn't sweep, no matter how hard I tried. So finally, i gave up and switched plans and designed the finish a different way.

My error :(
